settings.heading: Bring SWARAKSHIT Into Your Plant
settings.text: Industrial facilities require rigorous safety measures. Swarakshit helps floor managers and safety officers run routine checks for combustible gas leaks around heavy machinery, large storage tanks, complex pipeline networks, and industrial burners. Robust, rechargeable, and built to support your daily factory safety protocols.

settings.title: Industrial Kit No.1

settings.title: Industrial Kit No.2
settings.description: A Swarakshit gas monitoring setup designed for fixed-point usage near high-risk zones, allowing for consistent spot-checks near main supply lines or heavy manufacturing equipment.

settings.title: Industrial Kit No.3
settings.description: A comprehensive industrial safety setup for sprawling plants. Ideal for multi-point checking routines, providing wide coverage across multiple production lines and storage facilities.
